recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Follow up in HL7/kindling or the active Kindling source repository to pass narrative state for JSON example rendering and generate stable skip targets for XML and JSON pretty pages; then update the core templates only as needed to consume that fixed renderer behavior.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU2 FHIR-core change request to add an easy jump past narrative affordance to pretty-printed XML and JSON resource renderings because resource narratives can be large.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 11502. The corresponding git-svn commit e6adfacc23 added <%past-narrative-link%> only to source/template-example-xml.html; historical publisher code supported the placeholder for XML pages when narrative state was passed, while JSON pages were rendered without passing that state.
additional_context: The templates moved to tools/templates and are still active build inputs consumed by the external Kindling publisher dependency. The current XML template retains <%past-narrative-link%>, the current JSON template does not, and current Kindling source still loads both templates while calling processPageIncludes for JSON pages without narrative state. Current CI-rendered XML and JSON example pages checked during reconciliation did not emit a Jump past Narrative link.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No core source change was made because adding the placeholder to JSON alone would render blank with the current Kindling call path and would not create a JSON-side skip target after text.div.

related_jiras.note: Later narrative best-practice work changed the same XML/JSON example templates and preserved the XML placeholder, but it did not address the missing JSON jump-link wiring.
